prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game VFX texture, a single meticulously drawn celestial magic sigil for a Legendary light-element spell. Perfect orthographic front-on circle centered at exactly the middle; no perspective, no tilt, no oval distortion. A very intricate circular sacred-geometric diagram with 8 concentric independently readable fine-line rings, dense invented arcane glyphs, tiny astronomical ticks, radial subdivisions, interlocking rose-window geometry, slender star polygons, a luminous but slender central twelve-petal rosette, and micro-engraved ornamental filigree. The visual density should rival an elaborate anime celestial summoning circle: hundreds of delicate precise lines and tiny symbols with a coherent radial structure. Ivory-white light and pale champagne gold dominate; controlled iridescent gradient accents sweep around the circle through pearl mint, cyan, lavender, blush pink. Crisp thin luminous lines, restrained soft edge radiance, rich close-up detail. The diameter fills 88% of the canvas with a clean transparent safety margin. ALL negative spaces between every line, the open center spaces, and the entire surrounding background must be genuinely transparent alpha. Avoid any opaque disc, dark/black background, paper, checkerboard, muddy cloud halo, broad solid luminous blobs. No gate, architecture, wings, clouds, characters, scenery, weapons, readable English, labels, watermark, border, or extra separated icons. One complete unbroken elegant circular glyph texture, razor sharp, production-ready transparent RGBA. This image is a flat luminous line-art effect that will rotate as a world plane, so prioritize geometric precision and beautifully legible high-frequency detail rather than painterly realism.
